test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter cluster in the same way as the second letter cluster is related to the first letter cluster and the fourth letter cluster is related to the third letter cluster.

COMBINE : MOCENIB :: FURTHER : RUFREHT :: REVERSE : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09d5665a62d3c3df769592fd7ca5ea0045efe6ddaa00239d0b33f7db70243d89.png] 

The logic followed here is:

COMBINE : MOCENIB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6df236138f4fa3492222de6d8ac22d650ebc088fbdbfb08298a2caee26c3aa4.png] 

FURTHER : RUFREHT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2311c4e9934a691f3b1a414baf70cae4e579fa4197cb3b1c4a83e4311eb410f4.png] 

Similarly, **REVERSE : ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbf1f8cace34444771b23d5d2b8809127b1facfe4ce88d51ac130ef11fa91a4a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"VERESRE".**
